name: Unbreakable Resolve (Grit, Pact)
body:
Your thirst for revenge is unwavering.

Prerequisite(s): Amateur Gunslinger or grit class feature, bind spirit class feature.

Benefit: While you are bound to a spirit, you can spend 1 grit as an immediate action in order to gain DR 1/– and resistance 5 against all types of energy damage against attacks made or spells cast by any creature that qualifies as your bound spirit’s favored enemy until the end of the turn. When your binder level reaches 5th and every five levels thereafter, increase the DR that you receive from this feat by 1 and the resistance by 5, up to DR 5/– and energy resistance 20.
